name: Embedding override vectors bind to their declared token positions
property: Provided embedding vectors replace exactly the intended placeholder positions in each query/item sequence; batching and ordering preserve this binding, while inconsistent counts are rejected.
difference: SGLang uses a placeholder token and PositionalEmbeds for scoring query/items; vLLM accepts prompt_embeds and validates mask/placeholder positions in its input processor/renderer.

name: Parallel tensor reconstruction plan follows declared sharding
property: Given tensor dimension annotations and rank topology, a diagnostic comparator chooses a reconstruction sequence and rank groups consistent with the declared sharding, and rejects inconsistent layouts.
difference: No matching vLLM diagnostic reconstruction test located in this batch; this is an SGLang-specific auxiliary diagnostic obligation, not whole-request correctness.

name: Parallel axis dependency and replication declarations are consistent
property: Given dimension and rank annotations, dependent and replicated axes are identified consistently; invalid dependent or overlapping replication claims are rejected.
difference: Auxiliary comparator planning; no corresponding vLLM obligation established in this batch.

name: Comparator report reflects declared baseline/target dump relation
property: For specified baseline and target diagnostic dumps and comparison options, emitted comparison records, summary, exit status and optional report follow the measured tensor relation and declared filtering/alignment policy.
difference: Diagnostic comparator extension; a vLLM analogue has not been established in this source batch.

name: Configured network endpoint has correct canonical representation
property: For supported IPv4, IPv6 and hostname forms, host and port parsing and URI formatting preserve the address; malformed forms are rejected before transport setup.
difference: SGLang uses immutable NetworkAddress with parse/to_url/to_tcp; vLLM provides split_host_port/join_host_port and IPv6 validation functions. Both express address representation, not live reachability.
